text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Overdraft Policy v3.0, Harbor charges a Courtesy Pay fee of $29 per item, up to a maximum of 3 items per business day. Separately, if an Overdraft Transfer Protection transfer from a linked Primary Share Account is used, only one $5.00 transfer fee is charged per business day, regardless of how many items it covers. No overdraft fee is charged at all if the account is overdrawn by $25.00 or less at day's end.","cited_chunk_ids":["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The Overdraft Policy v3 section 4 directly states the per-item fee and the daily cap of three items, plus the daily transfer fee cap and de minimis exception."}
